canonicalName: Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes Project
summary: Merge the standalone Grand Falls-Windsor row into the existing Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes Project. The final government VFM proves that one ProjectCo, Fengate Central Health, LP, and one Project Agreement cover both 60-bed facilities, with Fengate-managed funds providing project risk capital. The individual facility remains active but is not a separate manager-level PortCo.
blockingQuestions: Resolve the legal limited partners and percentages in Fengate Central Health, LP and whether SEC Pomerleau retained equity after financial close before asserting a complete active-owner cap table.
